slots.title: What do missed enquiries *cost* you?
slots.body: No industry averages. Just your own numbers, in three steps.
points: Step 3: what a job is worth

slots.title: Count the *missed* ones
slots.body: In a normal week, how many calls go unanswered or messages wait too long? That's A.

slots.title: How many would you *win*?
slots.body: Out of every 10 enquiries you answer well, how many become paid work? That's B.

slots.title: What's one job *worth*?
slots.body: Your typical job value. That's C.
points: Use a typical job, not your best
Leave out repeat work for now

slots.title: A × B ÷ 10 × *C*
slots.body: That's the work that may be slipping away each week. Multiply by 52 for a year.

slots.title: Your number is the *reason*
slots.body: VENTRA is being built to answer and book those enquiries for you. In sandbox testing now; launching soon.
